name: wt-secret-guard
description: Private function-hook secret scrubber for Bash results and pasted prompts

opAccount.title: 1Password account passed to `op read --account` (empty = the CLI's default account)
opAccount.description: Account passed as `op read --account <value>` when references are rewritten; leave empty on a single-account machine. OP_ACCOUNT does not reach op.exe through WSL interop.

opBinary.title: 1Password CLI executable the hook runs for `op read` (e.g. `op.exe` under WSL interop)
opBinary.description: The hook's own process capability spawns this executable; shell aliases do not apply there. Default `op`; under WSL, set `op.exe` when the Windows 1Password CLI is the signed-in one.
